title: 第9章 又要被坑？-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》
content:
第(1/3)页

    果然不出矮大紧所料，魏沐没有答应签约音乐公司。

    因为没必要。

    他现在要咖位没咖位，要名气没名气，就是一个小透明。

    贸然去签经纪公司，只会落得和前世一个下场，签署各种不平等条约。

    到时候歌曲版权跟他没有一点关系。

    他可不想像某些歌手那样，唱自己的歌还要掏钱！！

    更可气的是，掏钱都不给你唱，就是恶心你。

    就比如许嵩，他已经和分贝网闹掰了，后者未经他的同意私自把他的歌曲拿去做商业用途。

    接下来几天，魏沐往返于学校和录音棚，每天早出晚归，神秘兮兮的，搞得另外三个舍友一脑袋雾水。

    ........

    这天清晨，魏沐在生物钟的作用下起床。

    刚刚睁开眼，就见到三个大汉站在他面前，三双眼睛好奇的打量着他。

    “你们要干什么？”

    魏沐下意识裹紧了身上的被子。

    这一幕太陌生了。

    宿舍里四个人，除了他和杜江，另外两个都是夜猫子。

    郑恺经常夜不归宿，喜欢拉着陈贺出去，有的时候去夜店，有的时候去网吧打游戏。

    今天这俩人居然跟着杜江一块站在他床边。

    要不是知道这俩人性取向，他差点都要跳窗。

    哦不....跳窗还是算了，这是六楼。

    “老魏，你最近很奇怪啊？”

    陈贺磨搓着下巴，皱了皱颇有戏剧感的眉毛。

    “对啊，你最近一大早就走，晚上九十点才回来。一天也就算了，怎么天天这样？”，郑恺接着道。

    “难道是进了新剧组？或者是被大姐姐收了。”

    “收什么收，咱有正事。”

    杜姜：“什么正事？”

    “我写了一首歌，最近在忙着录音。”

    他没有说找矮大紧录歌，否则这三人就要追着他问。

    作为一个西格玛男人，魏沐认定了一件事就要把它做好。

    不管是男人，还是女人都不能阻挡他的脚步。

    以后有的是机会在舍友面前装逼，干嘛非要现在呢。

    他要确保万无一失。

    “录歌？”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

As expected, Wei Mu did not agree to sign with the music company.

Because it’s not necessary.

He wants to be a celebrity but not a celebrity. He wants to be famous but not famous. He is just a little transparent.

If you rush to sign a contract with a brokerage company, you will only end up with the same fate as in your previous life, signing various unequal treaties.

When the time comes, the copyright of the song will have nothing to do with him.

He doesn’t want to be like some singers who have to pay to sing their own songs!!

What’s even more annoying is that they don’t even pay to sing for you, they just disgust you.

“ Take Xu Song, for example, who has already broken up with Decibel.com, which used his songs for commercial purposes without his consent.

In the next few days, Wei Mu went back and forth between school and the recording studio, leaving early and returning late every day. He was so mysterious that the other three roommates were confused.

........

Early that morning, Wei Mu got up under the influence of his biological clock.

As soon as he opened his eyes, he saw three big men standing in front of him, three pairs of eyes looking at him curiously.

"What are you going to do?"

Wei Mu subconsciously wrapped the quilt tightly around him.

This scene is so unfamiliar.

There are four people in the dormitory, except for him and Du Jiang, the other two are night owls.

Zheng Kai often stays up late at night and likes to take Chen He out. Sometimes he goes to nightclubs, and sometimes he goes to Internet cafes to play games.

Today, these two people actually followed Du Jiang and stood beside his bed.

If he hadn’t known about the sexual orientation of these two people, he would have almost jumped out of the window.

Oh no... Forget about jumping out of the window, this is the sixth floor.

"Old Wei, have you been acting strange lately?"

Chen He rubbed his chin and wrinkled his dramatic eyebrows.

"Yes, you left early in the morning recently and didn't come back until ninety o'clock in the evening. Forget about one day, why do you do this every day?" Zheng Kai continued.

"Did he join a new crew? Or maybe he was accepted by the big sister."

"Take whatever you want, we have business to do."

Du Jiang: "What's the business?"

“I wrote a song and I’ve been busy recording it recently.”

He didn’t say to ask Gao Dajin to record a song, otherwise these three people would have chased him and asked.

As a Sigma man, Wei Mu is determined to do one thing well.

“Neither man nor woman can stop him.

There will be plenty of opportunities to show off in front of roommates in the future, why do you have to do it now?

He wants to make sure nothing goes wrong.

"Recording songs?"
